description: This file defines a class 'InputPostprocDoubleTap' that processes touch input events to detect double taps based on configurable timing and distance thresholds. It interacts with Kivy configuration and vector utilities, and manages internal touch state to identify double tap gestures.

classes.name: InputPostprocDoubleTap
classes.description: A post-processor class for detecting double tap gestures on touch input, configurable via Kivy settings.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the double tap detector with configuration parameters for distance and time thresholds.

methods.name: find_double_tap
methods.description: Searches for a previous touch that qualifies as a double tap based on distance, timing, and profile.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes a list of touch events to identify and mark double taps, maintaining internal state.
